# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

[CI](workflows/ci.yml) validates pull requests and main pushes on standard GitHub-hosted runners. Native Windows jobs use PowerShell and contribute to `all checks passed`; Python standalone runtimes retain all five native targets. Keep model-account calls, expectation refresh, and publication out of automatic CI. The [hosted CI decision](../.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-10-25-agentharness-hosted-ci.md) owns runner selection; release workflows own protected publication and wheel validation. Do not restore private upstream runner labels or fallback routing.
